definitions.gloss: acquisition, mastery, learning (of a skill or knowledge)
definitions.explanation: The process of learning and gaining proficiency in a skill, technique, language, or body of knowledge through study and practice.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{習得|しゅうとく}する。
{外国語|がいこくご}の{習得|しゅうとく}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: Acquiring a foreign language takes time.

examples.japanese: {研修|けんしゅう}プログラムを{通|つう}じて{実践的|じっせんてき}なスキルを{習得|しゅうとく}することができる。
examples.english: You can acquire practical skills through the training program.

notes:
USAGE:
More formal and deliberate than {覚|おぼ}える (to memorize/learn). {習得|しゅうとく} implies sustained effort and practice leading to real proficiency, while {覚|おぼ}える is more about memorizing individual facts. Common in educational and professional contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {取得|しゅとく}: obtaining (a qualification, license) — focuses on the result
- {修得|しゅうとく}: completing coursework — focuses on academic credits

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}を{習得|しゅうとく}する: to acquire a technique
- {言語|げんご}を{習得|しゅうとく}する: to acquire a language
- {習得|しゅうとく}に{時間|じかん}がかかる: to take time to learn
